_comment: Topic queue for scripts/blog/draft.mjs. Generated from docs/seo/KEYWORD-PLAN.md. status: queued -> drafted -> published (or skipped). Each topic supports exactly one target page (supports); never queue two topics for the same keyword.

secondary: how to build an edtech app
topics.angle: For edtech founders and test-prep brands: what to build first (student app, live classes, video, tests, payments), what breaks at scale (live classes, test windows, result days) and how to plan for it. Write as engineering advice; do not pitch a ready-made platform.
The most common reasons apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit or v0 break once real users arrive, and how to decide between fixing and rebuilding.

topics.keyword: is my AI generated app secure
topics.angle: A plain-English security checklist for founders who shipped an app built with an AI tool: exposed keys, open database tables, missing permission checks, payments.

secondary: how much does an AI chatbot cost
topics.angle: What drives the cost of a custom AI chatbot (channels, content, integrations, conversation volume, model choice) and how to scope a first version. Explain cost drivers; quote no prices.
What a WhatsApp AI chatbot can and cannot do for a business, what the WhatsApp Business Platform requires, and how hand-over to a human should work.
Clear definitions and when a business needs a chatbot, an AI agent or plain workflow automation, with examples.

secondary: how to choose an app development company
topics.angle: A buyer's guide to choosing a mobile app development company in India: what to ask, red flags, fixed price vs time and materials, code ownership, post-launch support.

secondary: how much does it cost to build an app
topics.angle: The factors that decide what an app costs to build and run (platforms, features, backend, design, integrations, maintenance). No price figures.
How white-label app development works for digital and marketing agencies: contracts, NDAs, branding, code ownership, pricing your clients, and how to pick a partner.
How to prepare a web or mobile app for predictable traffic spikes (launches, sales, live events, exam results): load testing, caching, autoscaling, queues, monitoring.
Practical ways to cut video delivery and cloud bills for apps that stream video: encoding ladders, CDN choice, caching, storage tiers. No invented savings figures.

topics.keyword: Next.js vs React for business website
topics.angle: When a business website or web app should use Next.js versus a plain React single-page app, with SEO, speed and hosting trade-offs.
How to scope, build and launch an MVP without wasting runway: what to cut, what never to cut (security, analytics), and how to work with a development partner.
